map.光泽是珍珠品质的灵魂。优质珍珠表面应能清晰反射物体影像，犹如镜面。光泽由珍珠质层: Luster is the soul of pearl quality. A fine pearl's surface should clearly reflect object images like a mirror. Luster is determined by the thickness and regularity of the nacre layers; thicker and denser layers give stronger luster.
map.指珍珠表面瑕疵(针点、隆起、裂纹、生长纹)的多少。完全无瑕者极为稀有，\"无瑕不: Refers to the amount of surface blemishes (pinpoints, bumps, cracks, growth lines). A perfectly flawless pearl is extremely rare — 'no flaw, no pearl' is trade slang. Evaluation is based on the front visible area.
map.正圆最珍贵，其次为圆、近圆、椭圆、水滴、纽扣形。巴洛克(异形)虽非正圆，但独特造: Perfect round is most precious, followed by round, near-round, oval, drop, and button. Baroque (irregular) shapes, though not round, have unique forms with collectible value.

map.光泽为什么最重要？: Why is luster the most important?
map.光泽(晕彩)是珍珠灵魂，强光泽可弥补微瑕；瑕疵不可逆但可被设计与镶嵌遮，故分级以: Luster (orient) is the soul of the pearl; strong luster compensates for minor flaws. Blemishes are irreversible but can be hidden by design and setting, so grading puts luster first.
map.按常见分级体系，瑕疵分无瑕 / 微瑕 / 少瑕 / 有瑕 / 多瑕，正圆无瑕极罕: Under common grading systems, blemishes are classed as flawless / minute / slight / marked / heavy; a perfectly round flawless pearl is extremely rare and its price rises exponentially. A practical criterion is 'social distance': flaws invisible to the naked eye at normal conversation distance (about 50 cm) are perfectly acceptable for daily wear and offer the best value; pursuing perfection usually doubles the budget. Also note that flaws around the drill hole and on the back have far less visual impact than those on the front.

map.AAA 就是最好的珍珠吗？: Does AAA mean the best pearl?
map.不是。AAA 只是本页固定权重算出的参考档，不代表 GIA/NGTC 等机构证书: No. AAA is only the reference band produced by this page’s fixed weights. It is not a GIA/NGTC certificate grade and cannot establish collector or auction value; real value also depends on variety, nacre, live luster and matching.
